title: MATERIAL OBLIGATORIO — Torrencial Chile by UTMB equipment page
publisher: UTMB World Series / Torrencial Chile by UTMB
claims: The event publishes a mandatory-equipment page for its races.
Equipment is checked at accreditation, before the start, during the race and after the finish.
The organiser may modify the mandatory list according to weather conditions and will notify participants before bib distribution opens for each race.
The organiser describes the mandatory list as a vital minimum that each runner must adapt to their own capacities.
The page states that the equipment must let runners handle cold and rain on the course and wait for help in safe conditions.
